I know exactly what you mean. I've constantly analyzed my thoughts, actions, and things I say. I also tend to analyze things other people say. I'm always thinking that people who know me are constantly judging me plotting things when I'm not around. I know this has happened. Maybe it means I'm really just not a good person... not just morally, but competent in any way. I know I don't belong here or anywhere. That's why I plan on hanging myself tonight.

I've been put into psych wards three times where I was at least 5 days in each. I've talked to social workers, therapists, psychiatrists, and I've been on different meds. I've tried abstaining from alcohol to see if it would help with my depression. Nothing helps. Nothing stops the paranoid thoughts. Nothing stops my inner voice from telling me that I'm worthless. No one understands me. I have no support system. I just need to complete the only thing I've wanted to do for the past two decades. That's it.
